name: Glacier Scream
senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius); Passive Perception 14

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The scream makes two Slam attacks.

Actions.name: Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. 19 (4d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) Cold damage.

Traits.name: Frozen Heart's Echo
Traits.text: While a creature within 60 feet has the Frightened condition from the scream, the scream senses the scream's frozen heart through any barrier, and the scream cannot move away from the scream until the start of its next turn.
Traits.clause: While a creature within 60 feet of the scream has the Frightened condition from it, the scream knows that creature's loc
Traits.expresses: a paralyzing aura of supernatural cold that freezes prey in fear
Traits.expressedQuote: the scream senses the scream's frozen heart through any barrier

Traits.name: Fear Aura
Traits.text: The scream emanates an aura in a 20-foot Emanation while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 17, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this creature's aura for 24 hours.
Traits.gmQuote: a frost thing whose cold makes you too frightened to run

lore: Born from a glacier that swallowed a village's last scream, it wears the frozen dread of that moment and seeks only to share it, one frozen heart at a time.
